name: jira-flow
description: Adds a single atlassian-expert worker plus Jira-aware slash commands (capture, plan-track-build-validate, execute, drain, advance) on top of any topology that ships planning-lead, engineering-lead, and validation-lead subagents — or any topology with a custom lifecycle declared in .claude/jira-flow.lifecycle.yaml (used by /advance). Tested with hex-backend, multi-team, and discovery. Won't work with solo-pair for the lead-based commands.
